blocks.content: Here is how we can implement binary search in Python:

1def perform_binary_search(array, target, low, high):
2
3    # Repeat until low index and high index meet
4    while low <= high:
5        
6        # logarithmically reduce operations 
7        mid = low + (high - low)//2
8
9        if array[mid] == target:
10            return mid
11        elif array[mid] < target:
12            low = mid + 1
13        else:
14            high = mid - 1
15            
16    # return -1 if target not found
17    return -1
18
19
20array = [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
21target = 4
22
23low = 0
24high = len(array) - 1
25result = perform_binary_search(array, target, low, high)
26
27print(f"The index of target is {result}")
